notes.title: How Survival and Rise: Being Alive grew so fast
notes.notes: [p]If you want to survive on the experimental island of "Survival and Rise: Being Alive", the first step for novices is crucial.[/p][p]Are you confused and at a loss when you first enter the game? Don't panic! Here is a super practical guide for novices to take you to the first day of the battle.[/p][p] [/p][p]1. Preparation for the start[/p][p]1. Mail rewards[/p][p]The mail will have service benefits. After receiving it, you can use gold coins to extract skins or talent points~[/p][p] [/p][p]2. Talent selection[/p][p]After registration, enter the talent interface first to extract free talent points. It is recommended to choose to increase "water resources" or "bandage" related talents to cope with the initial survival pressure.[/p][p] [/p][p]2. Novice guidance period[/p][p]1. Key position[/p][p]After entering the game, press the "/" key next to the right Shift to view all default key settings[/p][p]If you need to call out the mouse for operation, press the "~" key[/p][p] [/p][p]2. Birth site selection[/p][p]•Birth point: Survivors can go to places with rich resources first, such as near the highway or the dense material point area, to facilitate and quickly obtain resources, but at the same time the risk will be relatively large.[/p][p]• Site selection: Choose a safe place to build a house. Try to avoid dangerous areas, such as monster nests and conflict zones where other players often appear.[/p][p] [/p][p]3. Task guidance[/p][p]Follow the task guidance on the left to complete basic operations. The task will guide you to collect resources, build buildings, etc. Be sure to complete the steps to obtain the initial resource rewards.[/p][p] [/p][p]4. Territory cabinet[/p][p]The territory cabinet must be placed with enough wood. The right side will remind you of the corrosion time. Once the building is corroded, it will disappear and need to be rebuilt. Therefore, it is necessary to check the building status regularly and fill the materials in time.[/p][p] [/p][p]5. Bookshelf[/p][p]The bookshelf is mainly used to unlock technology, which is an important condition for the construction of the overall materials of the game. In the early stage, only the first 4 need to be unlocked, and then unlocked according to personal positioning.[/p][p] [/p][p]III. Resource collection[/p][p]1. Collect resources[/p][p]There are various resources in the game, such as wood, stone, iron ore, etc. These are necessary materials for building houses and making tools. Use the initial simple tools to collect resources in the surrounding area. When collecting, try to choose areas with rich resources to improve efficiency.[/p][p] [/p][p]2. Build a furnace[/p][p]• Build a furnace as soon as possible to burn ore and ****, which is the key to early development; it is recommended to build multiple furnaces to improve resource acquisition efficiency[/p][p]• Place the collected wood, stone, iron ore, linen, etc., and wood is required as fuel[/p][p] [/p][p]3. Material search[/p][p]There are usually some small buildings near the birth point, and you should explore these places first. Basic materials such as weapons, ammunition, food and medicine may be hidden in the house. Pay attention to searching corners, cabinets and boxes, and don't miss any place where materials may be hidden.[/p][p] [/p][p]4. Resource synthesis[/p][p]High-quality materials can be synthesized with low-quality materials. Click on the material to view the specific synthesis method and make rational use of resources[/p][p] [/p][p]4. Animal utilization[/p][p]Some small animals can provide food and materials. Learn to hunt and use these animals to meet your own survival needs.[/p][p] [/p][p]IV. Stronghold exploration period[/p][p]1. Proceed cautiously[/p][p]Don't rush into the advanced stronghold on the first day. First choose some \[level 1 strongholds marked in blue] on the map for exploration. The monsters and enemies in these strongholds are relatively weak and more suitable for novices.[/p][p] [/p][p]2. Observe the situation[/p][p]When approaching the stronghold, observe from a distance first to understand the distribution and patrol routes of the enemies in the stronghold. You can use the terrain and obstacles to quietly approach and avoid being discovered by the enemy.[/p][p] [/p][p]3. Reasonable fighting[/p][p]If you encounter an enemy, don't panic. Choose the appropriate fighting method according to your weapons and ammunition. If the weapon is weak, you can use guerrilla tactics to defeat the enemy one by one.[/p][p] [/p][p]V. Capture dinosaurs[/p][p]1. Taming dinosaurs[/p][p]If you encounter a dinosaur, don't attack it easily. Some dinosaurs can be tamed and become your mount or combat partner.[/p][p]You need to make a handy gun first and prepare the props needed to capture dinosaurs: precision dinosaur hunting device, dinosaur riding device, dinosaur stable jam, dinosaur taming food, and tame it according to the method below.[/p][p] [/p][p]2. Capture steps[/p][p]• Place the \[Dinosaur Capture] around the dinosaur in advance.[/p][p]• When the dinosaur's health is reduced to 1/5, it will prompt "Captureable", seduce the dinosaur into the capture device.[/p][p]• Use \[Inject Tranquilizer] and \[Feed Tranquil Jam] in sequence, and finally install \[Dinosaur Ride] to tame the dinosaur[/p][p] [/p][p]VI. Teamwork[/p][p]• Try to play in a team, so that you can obtain and distribute resources more quickly, but if it is the early stage of team formation, be careful to prevent the risk of items being stolen[/p][p]• Join or create a team, participate in team activities, and get extra rewards.[/p][p] [/p][p]The first day is crucial in "Survival and Rise: Being Alive". Only by planning actions reasonably and developing steadily can you gain a foothold in this challenging game world. For more detailed gameplay, please refer to the strategy collection![/p]

notes.title: FAQ for beginners: Survival and Rise: Being Alive - Doomsday survival guide
notes.notes: [p]Hello, survivors![/p][p]This FAQ sorts out the most common basic questions to help you adapt to the survival challenge faster. If you are confused about the gameplay, or want to optimize your survival strategy, you may wish to check the following content.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][b]★★★ Basic Questions ★★★[/b][/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q: How to enter the game[/b][/p][p]A: After creating a character, click "Start Game" in the lower right corner of the preparation interface, and the system will default to the latest recommended battle situation[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q: The difference between Normal Mode and Battle Mode[/b][/p][p]A: The core gameplay of Normal Mode and Battle Mode is the same, the difference is that there are some differences in the rules, but Battle Mode can only be experienced after completing a full game in Normal Mode, and Battle Mode is entered in a team.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q: How to set up the game[/b][/p][p]A: 1. Find the small gear in the upper right corner of the preparation interface to set it up[/p][p]2. Click the green avatar in the upper left corner of the battle interface, and click Settings on the right[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q: How to view the key settings in the battle[/b][/p][p]A: The "?/" key next to the right Shift key[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q: How to wake up the mouse in the battle[/b][/p][p]A: The "~" key next to the number 1 key[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q: What should I do when I first enter the battle?[/b][/p][p]A: Follow the task instructions on the left, gradually complete the task requirements, and slowly get familiar with the game[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q: How to team up with others?[/b][/p][p]A: You can add friends in the chat channel in the game, and you can invite them to form a team after becoming friends[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q: How to actively join a new battle[/b][/p][p]A: In the preparation interface, click on the normal mode and select the room number you want to go to[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q: How to change the gender of the character[/b][/p][p]A: Click on the avatar in the upper left corner of the preparation interface, click on change image; you can reselect the appearance[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q: Why is there a skin, but it is not displayed in the battle[/b][/p][p]A: You need to equip it in the warehouse of the preparation interface before it will be displayed in the battle[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q: Why do I die when I go online again[/b][/p][p]A: Before each game goes offline, you need to return to the rest area to avoid death[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q: Is there a time limit for leaving the team and rejoining?[/b][/p][p]A: You need to wait for a 24-hour cooling time[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q: How to switch accounts?[/b][/p][p]A: In the upper left corner of the preparation interface, click on the avatar-switch account[/p][p] [/p][p][b]★★★ Game activities ★★★[/b][/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q: Will the weekly sign-in gift activity disappear after 7 days?[/b][/p][p]A: The event is open continuously, and a new round of sign-in will be reopened after 7 days[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q: How to get the reward for the first recharge event[/b][/p][p]A: The conditions for receiving the reward are that you need to recharge any points to activate it. Other single paid activities cannot activate the reward[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q: How to get the medals in the medal store[/b][/p][p]A: The medals are obtained as rewards after the battle is settled, and cannot be obtained by recharging[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q: Can the daily recharge event be obtained by recharging any paid items?[/b][/p][p]A: No, only recharging points can activate the reward[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q: How to check the specific opening time of the activities in the battle[/b][/p][p]A: Every time you log in to the game, an event announcement will pop up. You can also click the avatar in the upper left corner-battle plan-combat deployment to view the corresponding event time[/p][p] [/p][p][b]★★★ Mount ★★★[/b][/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q: Which creatures in the game can be tamed as mounts[/b][/p][p]A: Currently only 3 forms of Velociraptor and Parasaurolophus, which can be tamed[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q: What are the conditions for taming a mount[/b][/p][p]A: You need to make a suitable gun first, and 4 props: "Precision Dinosaur Hunting Device", "Dinosaur Riding Device", "Dinosaur Calming Jam", and "Dinosaur Taming Food"[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q: Why do tamed mounts disappear?[/b][/p][p]A: Mounts have "durability" and need to be fed human food to survive[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q: Which mounts can generate electricity in a generator?[/b][/p][p]A: Only Parasaurolophus can generate electricity[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p]

notes.title: "Survival and Rise: Being Alive" Steam Beta Test FAQ
notes.notes: [p]Dear survivors:[/p][p] [/p][p]Welcome to the first PC trial of "Survival and Rise: Being Alive"! This is a hardcore survival game full of challenges and opportunities. Here, every resource and every decision will determine your fate. In order to help everyone experience the test version more smoothly, we have compiled this FAQ to answer common questions you may encounter.[/p][p] [/p][p]This test is designed to collect player feedback and optimize the game experience. If you encounter bugs, balance issues, or have any suggestions, please let us know through official channels - your voice will directly affect the final quality of the game![/p][p] [/p][p]Note: The trial test version does not represent the final content of the game, and some functions may still be under development or adjustment. Please make sure to indicate your system configuration and detailed description when submitting feedback, which will greatly help us locate the problem.[/p][p] [/p][p]Are you ready to take on the challenge of extreme survival? See you in the wilderness![/p][p]---------------------------------------------------------------------------[/p][p] [b]1. Basic information about the test[/b][/p][p]Q: When will the trial be conducted?[/p][p]A: The test will start at 10:00 UTC+8 on June 10, 2025. The specific time of the closed beta will be synchronized after it is determined. Please pay attention to the community and game announcements.[/p][p] [/p][p]Q: On which platform will this closed beta be available?[/p][p]A: It is only available on PC.[/p][p] [/p][p]Q: How to obtain the trial test qualification?[/p][p]A: There will be no number restrictions for this test. You can download it directly on the Steam store page.[/p][p] [/p][p]Q: Will the game data be retained after the test?[/p][p]A: No. The trial test is a deleted test, and all progress will be cleared after the test.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][b]2. Game download and operation[/b][/p][p]Q: How to download the trial test version?[/p][p]A: After obtaining the test qualification, you can find "Survival and Rise: Being Alive" in the Steam library and download the "Beta Test" branch.[/p][p] [/p][p]Q: What are the minimum configuration requirements for the game?[/p][p]A:[/p][p]OS: Windows 10 64-bit[/p][p]CPU: Intel i5-4460 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200[/p][p]RAM: 8GB[/p][p]GPU: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD Radeon R9 280[/p][p]Storage space: 15GB[/p][p] [/p][p]Q: What should I do if the game crashes/quickly exits?[/p][p] [/p][p]A:[/p][p]Update the graphics card driver to the latest version[/p][p]Verify the integrity of the game file (Steam library → right-click the game → Properties → Local files)[/p][p]Close the programs with high background usage[/p][p]If the problem still cannot be solved, please submit an error report to the official feedback channel[/p][p] [/p][p]Q: What should I do if the game freezes or drops frames during the game[/p][p]A: You can adjust the resolution, frame rate, image quality, anti-aliasing, vertical synchronization and other settings in the settings interface in the game[/p][p] [/p][p][b]3. Game content and mechanism[/b][/p][p]Q: What languages ​​will this Beta version support?[/p][p]A: Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese,[/p][p] [/p][p]Q: Does the game support multiplayer online?[/p][p]A: This test supports multiplayer online.[/p][p] [/p][p]Q: How to report BUG or balance issues?[/p][p]A: Please submit in the following ways:[/p][p][/p][p]Email to [url="https://support@rebirthsurvival.com"]support@rebirthsurvival.com[/url] (attach screenshots/videos and system configuration)[/p][p][/p][p] [b]4. Other FAQs[/b][/p][p]Q: Will patches be updated during the test?[/p][p]A: We will push hotfixes based on player feedback, and major updates will be announced in advance.[/p][p] [/p][p]Q: Does the game support controllers?[/p][p]A: Currently not supported, please use keyboard and mouse to get a complete experience.[/p][p] [/p][p]Q: What is the difference between the beta version and the official version?[/p][p]A: The beta version may have unfinished mechanisms, art resources or plot content. The official version will optimize the image quality, balance the gameplay and expand the content.[/p][p] [/p][p]Thank you for participating in the test journey of "Survival and Rise: Being Alive"! Every feedback from you will help this wasteland become more real and cruel.[/p]

notes.title: A new open world apocalypse survival game《Survival and Rise: Being Alive》
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536414/7a68caa770281a9b613ea07b5c985bdd18bfb30d.png[/img]
When the last rays of the sun disappear on the horizon, the continent full of dangers welcomes a new dawn. This is the doomsday world in "Survival and Rise: Being Alive". All survivors not only need to face the rampant mechanical bodies and biochemical mutants, but also need to rely on wisdom and teamwork to survive in this challenging wasteland continent!
Starting today, the PC version of "Survival and Rise: Being Alive" is officially open for reservations! This is an easy-to-use fair battle doomsday survival mobile game. You will freely form a team in a super large map, open up wasteland and build, and win the final victory in a fair duel. Come and start this immersive doomsday survival journey with us!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536414/9c9c1306a0ae617e23945eff7dde877dfae5c391.jpg[/img]
[Open world super large map immersive doomsday survival journey]
In order to experience the most realistic open doomsday survival world, survivors will share a server with hundreds of other players, and freely explore this world with 6 types of landforms, 16 types of large map gameplay, 59 types of hostile creatures, and a variety of weather systems. You need to collect resources, upgrade equipment, build or destroy shelters within a limited battle time, and compete with players on the same server for airdrops and resources to obtain battle points and determine the final ranking by exploring the map, attacking strongholds, and challenging BOSS. In addition, the game also has special and rich fun gameplay such as "Dinosaur Riding" and "Transforming into BOSS", which I believe are all worth a try.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536414/5cf86990a5fa8e9bab81c812a44a5ca0eefd5381.jpg[/img]
[A peaceful start, cooperative survival, conquer strongholds and dominate the wasteland]
In "Survival and Rise: Being Alive", the system will limit the PVP range for a period of time after each battle begins, which means that even survivors with no survival experience can use this time to concentrate on development and quickly get started. Survivors who are confident in their own strength can choose to go deep into the battle zone and compete with other survivors for valuable resources in advance!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536414/132e42a6cc2b10b91bf3b3a5dc6e186841ab0223.jpg[/img]
The various puzzle elements and threatening BOSS creatures scattered throughout the game map will also bring different fun and challenges to your survival journey. At the same time, there are strongholds of different difficulties located in the map. Survivors need to explore in depth, unlock numerous mechanisms, and challenge stronghold BOSS to win rich resource rewards.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536414/28ba34aeac5ad80b05b1f9364db5ffdbc6049f04.jpg[/img]
But opportunities often coexist with great dangers. Whether it is a deadly trap or a boss with special skills, fighting alone is not the best choice, so "cooperation and win-win" will be the main theme of each battle. The game allows up to four people to form a team to attack strongholds, challenge bosses, and face powerful opponents. Your tacit cooperation will make all this more handy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536414/49e559dcc28e75d55c2a4ee767d7719d7e111430.jpg[/img]
[Free sandbox gameplay, strategic deployment or extreme demolition? ]
After the PVP restrictions are lifted, survivors will face threats from hostile players. You and your teammates can deploy heavy machine guns, traps and other fortifications to flexibly resist attacks and sneak attacks from other survivors. The game also considerately shortens the construction waiting time to avoid meaningless time waste.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536414/671118b951f8bcfdcc83ecfe9b56a5c5f252d886.jpg[/img]
Of course, you can also choose to take the initiative to attack, besiege and destroy the enemy's shelter, and disintegrate its fortifications. In order to restore the apocalyptic combat experience, the game provides a large number of equipment accessories: from homemade weapons to heavy firepower weapons; from basic leather armor to future technology armor, all can be made and upgraded by collecting resources and winning spoils.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536414/3a8fdbc7f9c427ca3009c7bb223daa11faf31d85.jpg[/img]
[Hunting and riding dinosaurs, fun gameplay]
In addition to the real doomsday survival experience, practical and interesting gameplay has always been a major goal of game development. Survivors can hunt dinosaurs in the world, turn them into your exclusive mounts, and quickly move and chase enemies in the vast wasteland world; or use them for power systems. Just replenish food regularly, and your mount can continuously provide power for automatic rifle towers, battery boxes and other equipment, providing a solid foundation for the stable defense of the shelter. We welcome everyone to try this series of gameplay and experience the joy of every gallop in the super-large doomsday world!

We welcome all “survivors” to join the world of “Survival and Rise: Being Alive” and experience an immersive doomsday survival journey!
